subject: Hosted API evaluation — schedule and pre-demo checklist
messages:
From: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@ledgerstack.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API eval — quick call?

Hi Jasmine,

I signed up for the self-serve Hosted API sandbox yesterday and poked around our initial tests — thanks for making that available. We’d like a short 30-minute walkthrough focused on:
- latency at p95 for 1k/s burst patterns
- cost controls (batching / quantization) you recommend for prod
- what we should expect for multi-tenant vs dedicated behavior

Our team is small; I (Alex, product lead) + our ML engineer (Priya) will join. We prefer next-week slots (PDT), ideally morning. We’re flexible Tue/Wed.

Attached is a quick screenshot of our test run (small). Also pasted our sandbox note: token-sample-redacted.

Can an SDR/AE at Redwood help book a short slot and share a pre-demo checklist? We want to make sure we can test the exact throughput pattern during the session.

Thanks,
Alex Zhao
Product Lead, LedgerStack
alex.zhao@ledgerstack.com

I can do 30 minutes on:
- Tue 2027-05-25 09:30 PDT / 12:30 EDT
- Tue 2027-05-25 11:00 PDT / 14:00 EDT
- Wed 2027-05-26 08:30 PDT / 11:30 EDT

If none of those are a fit, here’s a quick booking link: https://cal.com/jasmine-liu/redwood-30

Pre-demo ask from our side — if you can send these ahead we can make the session hands-on: 
1) a short list of representative prompts and expected token lengths,
2) a rough QPS/throughput target (sustained vs burst),
3) any compliance constraints (region/data residency) we should know about.

I’ve attached a 1-page demo agenda and sandbox access instructions (small txt with commands). I’ll include a meeting invite once you pick a time.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — we’ll take Tue 2027-05-25 11:00 PDT (the second slot).

Priya (cc'd) will join from our side — she’s our ML engineer and will bring the perf scripts.

Quick answers to your pre-demo asks:
- sample prompts: small Q&A + 1 longer multi-turn dialog (I’ll drop the prompt file before the meeting).
- throughput: target is a sustained 200 req/s for short bursts up to 1k token bursts, p95 latency target ~200ms if possible.
- region: US (we prefer us-west/east run) — not an EU requirement for this eval.

We’re also tracking this in our internal pipeline (deal id LSK-4871). Uploaded a small architecture screenshot for context.

See you Tuesday.

— Alex
